// coding-misk · DCI Ignition
// song composed with sections and tracks: each track plays its clips, switched on by the section lane (1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade)
// each .analyze("…") lights up its instrument in the Stage visual
setcpm(106/4)

const SECTIONS = [['Crescendo', 11], ['Crescendo 2', 29], ['Stab', 4], ['Build', 4], ['Drop', 8], ['Switch', 4], ['Drop 2', 6], ['Coda', 2]]
const TEMPO = {'Crescendo': 106, 'Crescendo 2': 106, 'Stab': 106, 'Build': 106, 'Drop': 106, 'Switch': 106, 'Drop 2': 106, 'Coda': 106}

// section lanes: 1 plays, 0 is silent, values in between fade
const section1 = "<1!11 0!57>"  // Crescendo · 11 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m
const section2 = "<0!11 1!29 0!28>"  // Crescendo 2 · 29 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section3 = "<0!40 1!4 0!24>"  // Stab · 4 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section4 = "<0!44 1!4 0!20>"  // Build · 4 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section5 = "<0!48 1!8 0.5 0!11>"  // Drop · 8 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section6 = "<0!56 0.5 1!3 0!8>"  // Switch · 4 bars · 106 BPM · G · Gm Gm F F · fades in over 1 bars
const section7 = "<0!60 1!6 0!2>"  // Drop 2 · 6 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E
const section8 = "<0!66 1!2>"  // Coda · 2 bars · 106 BPM · F# · F#m F#m E E

// ========== drums ==========
// Crescendo · bars 1-11 · pattern D~3
// Drums · RolandTR909
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.72).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section1).velocity(section1).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Crescendo 2 · bars 12-40 · pattern D~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.72).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section2).velocity(section2).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Build · bars 45-48 · pattern A~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain("<0.3 0.5 0.7 0.9>").lpf("<600 7066.67 13533.33 20000>").distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask("<1!3 [1 0]>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ [hh ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain("<0.15 0.25 0.35 0.45>").lpf("<600 7066.67 13533.33 20000>").distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask("<1!3 [1 0]>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0!3 1>").mask(section4).velocity(section4).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
// Drop · bars 49-56 · pattern B~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0!7 1>").mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<1 0!7>").mask(section5).velocity(section5).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
// Switch · bars 57-60 · pattern C~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ ~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.72).distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).distort(0.6).distortvol(.5).mask(section6).velocity(section6).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
// Drop 2 · bars 61-66 · pattern D~3
$: s("[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section7).velocity(section7).orbit(1).analyze("kick")
$: s("~ [cp ~ ~ ~] ~ [cp ~ ~ ~]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.72).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section7).velocity(section7).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("[hh ~ ~ ~] ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.45).distort(1).distortvol(.5).mask(section7).velocity(section7).orbit(1).analyze("hats")
$: s("sd*16").bank("RolandTR909").gain(saw.range(.15, .75)).mask("<0!5 1>").mask(section7).velocity(section7).orbit(1).analyze("snare")
$: s("cr").bank("RolandTR909").gain(.55).room(.4).mask("<1 0!5>").mask(section7).velocity(section7).orbit(1).analyze("fx")
